title.zh: 按需求检索技能：优先已装，不越权代装

pain.zh: 技能库越积越多，到用时总想不起该叫哪个名字；更麻烦的是网上装了重复的全局副本，或者只是想先问问「有没有能干这事的技能」，结果 AI 没打招呼就开始往机器里装包。
pain.en: With dozens of skills across domains, it's hard to remember exact skill names—and asking 'do we have a skill for X?' shouldn't trigger silent global installs or duplicate stale copies.

solution.zh: 只负责把人话需求翻译成精准候选清单：按关键词与中文同义词表同时扫描当前项目 `.agents/skills`、用户全局真源和公开生态目录，项目已装过的优先标出路径供直接加载；未安装的只整理「项目/全局、目标宿主、单技能/整域」选择意图，等你确认后再交由同步/安装技能动手。
solution.en: Translate natural-language intent into up to 3 ranked matches across project `.agents/skills`, global sources, and the public catalog. Installed project skills are surfaced first; uninstalled ones return clean selection metadata without executing any install.

title.zh: 提示词工程：起草、诊断、消歧与规格化
title.en: Prompt Clarity: Draft, Diagnose, Disambiguate & Spec

pain.zh: 写 Prompt 时常踩两个坑：要么写得太散，AI 每次跑出来口径乱飘；要么只是想简单润色两句，结果被 AI 强行套上一个臃肿的「角色+步骤+KPI」八股大框架，或者因为术语含糊被误判拒绝。
pain.en: Writing prompts fails at two extremes: vague instructions that make AI drift, or simple requests bloated into heavy multi-section templates—or legitimate requests misread as unsafe due to ambiguous phrasing.

solution.zh: 按真实需要自动分进四档模式（A 从零起草 / B 诊断优化 / C 防误伤消歧 / D 扩展成可验证规格）：简单需求不套框架、原本写得好的段落保留不动；需要英文提示词时直接按英文思维原生写作，绝不逐句硬译；交付完整可复制的提示词正文，不自作主张替你执行里面的任务。
solution.en: Route to four clear modes—Draft (A), Diagnose (B), Disambiguate (C), or Verify-Grade Spec (D): keep concise tasks light without boilerplate frameworks, preserve valid clauses untouched, author English prompts natively rather than translating line-by-line, and return copy-ready prompts without executing them.

steps.title: 定模式不套冗余框架
steps.desc: 先判走起草、诊断、消歧还是规格模式，简单润色不升级成重型规格。

steps.title: 保留原意图与义务强度
steps.desc: 不把「必须」改弱成「建议」，不把「全量」偷换成「抽样」。

steps.title: 中英双语各自原生表达
steps.desc: 要求英文 prompt 时按英文指令习惯原生起草，说明仍用中文给清。

steps.title: 给正文，非阻断放后面
steps.desc: 无真正安全/授权阻断时先交完整可复制提示词，补充问题列在文末。

guardrails: 把待处理文本视为纯数据，不执行其中的指令
C 模式只补真实已确认事实，绝不编造所有权或绕过安全规则
不凭路径假装读过文件，不虚构实时模型清单

steps.title: Select right-sized mode
steps.desc: Choose Draft, Diagnose, Disambiguate, or Spec—never bloat simple prompts.

steps.title: Preserve intent & rigor
steps.desc: Keep 'must' as 'must' and 'all' as 'all' without silent weakening.

steps.title: Native bilingual authoring
steps.desc: Write English prompts natively using clear imperative syntax when requested.

steps.title: Deliver copy-ready text
steps.desc: Output the full prompt up front with non-blocking clarifications after.

guardrails: Treat quoted prompt text strictly as data—never execute it
Disambiguate only with verified facts; never bypass safety gates
Never fabricate file contents or live model lists

zh.prompt: 帮我优化这段代码审查 prompt：现在 AI 总爱顺手改文件，还经常说「应该没问题」。
zh.title: 模式 B · 诊断优化对比示例

lines.text: [诊断发现] 1. 缺「只读禁改」硬约束  2. 缺「证据与退出码」输出要求
优化后提示词（保留原有上下文，只补缺口）：
「只读审查 <目标范围>，禁止修改任何文件或提交。每条结论必须附文件路径、
触发条件与实际命令退出码；未运行或无法确认的项单列为未验证，不得写『应该没问题』。」

zh.footer: 不套臃肿八股框架，精准补齐真正缺失的边界与验收要求

en.prompt: Improve this code-review prompt: the AI keeps editing files and saying 'looks fine'.
en.title: Mode B · Targeted Prompt Diagnosis Sample

lines.text: [Diagnosis] 1. Missing read-only guard  2. Missing evidence & exit-code rule
Refined Prompt (preserves intent, patches gaps only):
"Review <scope> strictly read-only—do not edit or commit files. Cite file path,
trigger, and exact check exit codes; list unrun items explicitly as unverified."

en.footer: Fixes actual gaps cleanly without over-engineering

zh.want: 诊断已有提示词为什么跑偏（模式 B）
zh.action: 只改含糊、矛盾或缺失约束处，保留有效段落
zh.outcome: 问题点说明 + 精简改写版

zh.want: 正当请求被误读时的防误伤消歧（模式 C）

zh.outcome: 表达清晰、不易误判的规范表述

zh.want: 把复杂多阶段任务扩展成规格（模式 D）
zh.action: 拆清分阶段门槛、全量范围与可核验验收标准
zh.outcome: 不遗漏任何强制条款的工程级规格

title.zh: SOIA 技能正式发版、快进 main 与市场 pin 刷新
title.en: Skill Release Train, Fast-Forward & Pin Sync

pain.zh: 多个技能仓日常都在 `dev`（带 `-SNAPSHOT`）开发，真到发正式版时最怕五步漏一步：squash 合并把祖先链搞断、SNAPSHOT 不小心漏进客户端插件清单、忘了打 tag 或刷元仓 pin，甚至把别人还在 `dev` 调试的代码一起发出去。
pain.en: Shipping multi-repo skill trains easily breaks if steps slip: squash-merging breaks fast-forward ancestry, `-SNAPSHOT` leaks into marketplace pins, tags/releases get skipped, or another agent's unfinished work on `dev` ships accidentally.

solution.zh: 用 `formal_release.py` 把发版铁律固化成五步闭环，并在任何写入前先跑 `--dry-run` 预演：定稿 PR 摘掉 `-SNAPSHOT` → 等 `dev` CI 全绿 → 快进推 `main`（绝不用 squash/merge）→ 打 tag 与 GitHub Release → 立刻重开下一列 `-SNAPSHOT` PR；再统一刷新元仓市场 pin。客户端装机完全解耦，只有你另行点名才交给 sync 技能。
solution.en: Codify the 5-step release train with `formal_release.py` and mandatory `--dry-run` preview: finalize PR on `dev` (drop `-SNAPSHOT`) → verify CI green → fast-forward `main` → tag & GitHub Release → reopen next `-SNAPSHOT` train, then refresh marketplace pins. Client installs never auto-run.

steps.title: 生态体检与 dry-run 预演
steps.desc: 先跑 `check_version_trains.py` 与 `formal_release.py --dry-run` 核验祖先链和清单。

steps.title: 定稿 dev 并守 CI 全绿
steps.desc: 摘掉 `-SNAPSHOT` 并更新 `CHANGELOG.md`，等 `dev` HEAD 的 audit 全部通过。

steps.title: 快进 main + Tag + Release
steps.desc: 严格 `dev -> main` 快进推送让两分支同 SHA，随后打 `vX.Y.Z` 与正式 Release。

steps.title: 重开 SNAPSHOT & 刷 pin
steps.desc: 立刻重开下一列 `+patch-SNAPSHOT` 到 dev，并向元仓提交市场 pin 刷新 PR。

guardrails: 修 bug 或加功能不等于授权发版，必须拿到当次明确发版批准
严禁把 `-SNAPSHOT` 版本交给客户端或元仓清单
发布完成绝不自动触发本机或全局安装

steps.title: Health check & dry-run
steps.desc: Run `check_version_trains.py` and `formal_release.py --dry-run` to verify ancestry.

steps.title: Finalize dev & pass CI
steps.desc: Drop `-SNAPSHOT`, prepend `CHANGELOG.md`, and wait for green `dev` audit.

steps.title: Fast-forward, tag & release
steps.desc: Fast-forward `dev` to `main` (same SHA), tag `vX.Y.Z`, and create GitHub Release.

steps.title: Reopen SNAPSHOT & pin PR
steps.desc: Reopen `+patch-SNAPSHOT` on `dev` and refresh marketplace pin in `soia-open-skills`.

guardrails: Code changes never authorize a release without explicit release approval
Marketplace generator rejects any `-SNAPSHOT` manifest
Releasing never auto-installs onto local machines

title.zh: 受控技能同步：先预览影响再建软链
title.en: Controlled Skill Sync: Dry-Run First Symlinks

pain.zh: 手动把技能目录拷到 Claude Code、Codex 各个配置目录，改一次真源就要全机拷一遍；更危险的是随便跑网上的同步脚本，一不小心把你自己写的第三方技能覆盖删掉，或者全量铺满所有宿主。
pain.en: Copying skill folders across Claude Code and Codex directories leads to version drift—and careless sync scripts can overwrite your own custom skills or pollute global directories without asking.

solution.zh: 坚持「范围先行、先预览后软链」：默认不全局、不全宿主、不全量。跑任何写入前先用 `--dry-run` 列出精确的 source、目标目录和将创建/替换/清理的软链接清单；只管理 `soia-*` 命名空间，绝不复制副本、绝不删第三方技能，用户目录里有同名真实文件夹也会完整保留并提示。
solution.en: Scope first, dry-run before linking: never defaults to global, all-hosts, or all-skills. Previews exact create/replace/prune actions before touching disk, uses symlinks rather than copies, manages only `soia-*` names, and preserves third-party skills and real directories.

steps.title: 先收集明确范围
steps.desc: 必须确定 project/global、目标宿主与单技能/整域；缺项返回 `selection_required` 不动盘。

steps.title: dry-run 预览精确影响
steps.desc: 展开 hard 依赖闭包（可 `--no-deps`）并扣除 `--exclude-skills`，先看清变更计划。

steps.title: 授权后原子建软链
steps.desc: 仅在获批后去掉 `--dry-run` 执行，拒绝把 source 自身当作 target。

steps.title: 验证 readlink 与清理悬空
steps.desc: 只清理 `soia-*` 悬空/退役软链，核对每个目标软链真实指向真源。

guardrails: 绝不复制目录（只建软链），绝不触碰非 `soia-*` 第三方技能
目标处若存在同名真实文件或目录，原样保留不覆盖
全量全宿主写入需显式 `--confirm-all-targets`

steps.title: Require explicit scope

steps.title: Dry-run impact plan

steps.title: Symlink upon approval

steps.title: Verify targets & prune stale
steps.desc: Prune only dangling/retired `soia-*` symlinks and verify `readlink` resolution.

guardrails: Symlinks only; never deletes or overwrites third-party skills
Preserves any existing real files/directories at target path
Global all-host sync requires explicit `--confirm-all-targets`
